checks.projection: All four native and enlarged facings retain the fixed 40-degree top-down projection, visible upper backs and distinct near/far limb depths. No cell-fitting scale change was applied.
checks.anatomy: Opened every chronological walking and ear/tail frame in compact fixed-anchor panels. Low quadruped bodies remain connected to four solved limbs; rear views contain rear skulls without front facial decals.
checks.headVolume: The stabilized rigid skull follows evaluated body translation. Fixed authored head templates keep their pixel dimensions throughout walking; the ears articulate separately without resizing the head.
checks.contacts: Saved-scene audits check actual sole positions, ground clearance and constant-length links at every pose/facing. Native/enlarged panels retain alternating feet beneath the moving torso, with brief far-paw occlusion at crossings.
checks.continuousPlayback: Bundled full Chromium captured complete two-walk/action/idle sequences at 1x and 4x. All 21 cat or 25 dog poses were observed per scale; every four-facing crop matches its source pixels. Travel playback uses the authored stride.
checks.sceneScale: Opened native/enlarged scenes beside the unchanged Explorer, actual Modern Exteriors tree, roof and cars. Cats remain smaller than dogs; all four use the original world-pixel density and ground anchors.
checks.weightTransfer: Final native walk panels visibly move the upper body/head by roughly one pixel while planted feet stay grounded. Evaluated shoulder and pelvis trajectories differ under rigid torso pitch; the leg solve compensates rather than bouncing a finished sprite. Every facing passes the projected-motion and stance-travel audit.

pets.cat-ginger: Warm orange coat, cream muzzle/mittens, fixed dark forehead marks and torso-anchored tabby stripes remain recognizable through the walk; raised tail and ear flick retain the cat silhouette.
pets.cat-black: Solid charcoal coat has restrained blue-gray upper surfaces and golden eyes. It has no white tuxedo bib/mittens; rear and profile foot separation is subtle but present against grass.
pets.dog-golden: Full golden coat replaces the black beagle saddle/blaze; softer longer pendent ears and a lower gently wagging tail distinguish the compact retriever interpretation. It remains deliberately stylized at native scale.
pets.dog-shepherd: Tan coat and black saddle pair with separate triangular upright ear geometry and a lower tail. Profile/rear ears remain readable; frontal ears and far feet are partly occluded by the small skull/body.

limits: One-pixel motion quantization, quiet actions and short far-paw occlusions remain. Dog breed shapes are compact stylizations, not detailed breed-standard illustrations. Agent inspection is not human approval; all new exact candidates are pending.
